_comment: Both entry shapes are valid in the same file.
A LIST is a flat pool (movie-style). The same list serves single-clip mode
(best match wins) and --multipart (all matched, arranged chronologically).
A DICT is categorised (TV-style): --category pulls one bucket, omitting it
pools them all. Keys must match what `scan` reports; lookup falls back to a
normalized fuzzy match, so minor punctuation drift is tolerated.
Delete this _comment key in your real file.
The Empire Strikes Back: Do or do not. There is no try.

I do what I do best, I take scores.
